name: Hotel Fine Jeju
detail: It is close to Seogwipo Harbor, making it great for views of the sea and sunrises. The room was spacious and comfortable for the price. It was clean, the bathroom was also large, and the bathtub was very nice. I liked that the room and living area were separate, so the guest room didn't feel cramped.

name: Hotel Zinc
detail: The location is good and the cleanliness of the accommodation is also okay. I especially appreciated that you sent several addresses for free public parking that can be used when the parking lot is full! The front desk staff who checked me in were very kind and I was pleased! I recommend it!

name: HOTEL NANTA JEJU
detail: The bedding is really neat and cozy!! There is also a baby bed guard. The microwave is usable! The view of both the sea and the mountains was very nice. I heard the breakfast is delicious, but I couldn't use it this time. I will definitely try it next time.
area: Halla Mountain National Park,Jeju - View on map

name: Mangrove Jeju City
detail: I was debating where to book accommodation for a short trip to Jeju, which was just for one night and two days. I ended up making a reservation based on a friend's recommendation. The location near the airport allowed me to enjoy my short schedule fully. It was my first time using automated check-in/check-out, and it was more convenient than I expected! I was very satisfied with the room condition for the price. The room was spacious, and the remodeling was done cleanly. The refrigerator was larger than those in typical hotels, and having a desk, sofa, and coffee table was fantastic! If I had to point out a downside, it would be the lack of a TV, but since I don’t watch TV much while traveling, it wasn’t an issue for me at all. I was pleasantly surprised by the free breakfast, which had a good variety. Having a simple breakfast of cereal, eggs, fruit, and coffee filled me up nicely for the day. There was a convenience store nearby, the Dongmun Market was within walking distance, and the seaside walking path was close, so I stayed very satisfied. I plan to recommend this place to acquaintances who are visiting Jeju next!

name: Hotel Leo
detail: The location is very close to the Lotte Duty-Free Shop, which is very convenient for families with children. There is also a park with a slide suitable for preschoolers nearby (Samsam Park), making it perfect for dads to take the kids to the park while moms shop at the duty-free store~ 😂 There are also many bus routes near the hotel, making it very convenient. The rooms are relatively large and quite clean.

name: Maison Glad Jeju
detail: The room is spacious and clean. Above all, the location is right in the city center, making it convenient for meals and shopping after sightseeing. It’s easy to find tasty places, and you can walk there. The breakfast is really delicious 😋. It's definitely a candidate for when I go again!

name: Nonday Laboratory
detail: The environment here is really nice, and the location is very convenient; it's only 50 meters to the East Gate Market and the bus station. The mattress and pillows are made of silicone, which makes for a very comfortable sleep. The staff, including the older sisters and brothers, are all super nice! They are very responsive to requests. Breakfast is served until eleven o'clock, and it includes simple milk, cereal, toast, and jam. Everyone is very polite and quiet. The microwave and refrigerator are all available, creating wonderful memories ❤️ I will come back next time~~

name: Jeju Visitor Guesthouse
detail: I arrived late in the evening and left early in the morning, so I couldn't use other facilities at the accommodation, but the bedding was dry and everything was clean and nice. Self check-in and check-out is available, but lights out is at 11 PM, so for those coming in late, it might be difficult to shower without disturbing others (it seems the staff only stays until before 11 PM). There are many buses from Jeju Airport, and it's within a 5-minute walk from the bus stop, so accessibility is good. However, for those taking the first flight in the morning, it might be a bit difficult to get to the airport by 5:30-6 AM since there are no cars available. I tried to catch a taxi before the first bus, but I couldn't find one and had to wait for a while. Just a heads up about that! Other than that, I was very satisfied with the accommodation!

name: Urbanstay Jeju Airport
detail: There was no smell of cigarettes, and it was pleasant. (However, there was a strange herbal smell like medicine in the hallway?? I don't know what it was, but I passed by quickly without breathing.) I found it very convenient to have a washing machine since I was staying long, and the table was spacious, making it easy to eat takeout. Also, there were many bus stops nearby, which made it convenient to get around. The bathroom might be a bit small for men. The luggage storage was convenient and safe, and I used it well before check-in and after check-out. However, I didn't know how to get water and towels, so I bought water and used the towels I had with me for washing. 😭

name: Playce Camp Jeju
detail: The plan here is to take Route 1 and 1-1, so we chose this place, which is right at the end of Line 1, and after finishing we can immediately go back to shower and rest. Room: It is very sufficient for one person, but a bit cramped for two. All the necessary facilities are available, and it is very clean. Perhaps because the room is small, the air conditioning is a bit noisy; if you are sensitive to noise, you may want to choose carefully, but it did not affect me at all. Surroundings: There are many small restaurants, and a very famous bakery, as well as convenience stores, making it very convenient. Transportation: It's not far from the station, so dragging a suitcase over isn’t a big problem. You can take the express train from the airport, and it's also very convenient to go to Seogwipo.
